title: ✅ All 14 scenarios passed — new Vitals system added
summary: All 14 Webots integration scenarios passed (100% pass rate). This PR introduces the new `robonix-vitals` health monitoring system, including Soma health stream ingestion, component-tree normalization, threshold matching, and state-change push. The CI exercised existing capabilities (camera, lidar, explore, navigation, memory, speech, voiceprint, scene, executor builtins) and flow scenarios (fault recovery, object navigation, patrol observe). No regressions detected.
pr_changes: Added new system/vitals crate with gRPC health monitoring services (GetVitals, StreamVitals)
Added Soma health stream ingestion (StreamHealth) with threshold evaluation rules
Added mock Soma server with 5 scenarios (normal, ramp, fault, toggle, mixed) for development
Added hardware bridge subprocess support for Piper (CAN) and Koch (Dynamixel) arms
Added new IDL messages: SomaHealthSnapshot, ComponentStatus, ActuatorState, FaultState, PowerSourceState, SafetyState, VitalsSnapshot, BodyHealth, ComponentHealth, PowerState

Added new capability contracts: robonix/service/vitals/get, robonix/service/vitals/stream, robonix/system/soma/get_health, robonix/system/soma/health, robonix/primitive/health/state, robonix/primitive/health/stream
Updated Cargo.toml workspace members and Makefile build targets to include system/vitals
Updated Cargo.lock with new dependencies (defmt, env_logger, jiff, proc-macro-error2, portable-atomic-util, robonix-vitals)
test_result: 14/14 scenarios passed: builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, run_command), cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). All leaf calls succeeded as expected, including expected failures (missing file, explore timeout, invalid memory save args).
suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor the new Vitals system in future CI runs to ensure Soma ingestion and threshold evaluation work correctly with real hardware bridges.
risks_or_watchouts: New Vitals system is not yet exercised in CI scenarios — no test covers the health monitoring pipeline
Hardware bridge subprocesses (piper_bridge.py, koch_bridge.py) require external SDKs not present in CI environment
Mock Soma scenarios are for development only; production behavior depends on real Soma implementation
TTL-based STALE detection is not yet implemented (noted in soma_ingest.rs TODO)
